ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution exceeding 90% of total fluke area, with high-intensity (white) pixels appearing as sparse, thin-line disruptions and localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation covering both lobes. High-contrast white pixel clusters are distributed as non-uniform linear streaks across the central and distal regions, with higher density visible on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep vertical-axis penetration; internal angle estimated between 30 and 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the entire boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies significantly, with distinct jagged protrusions on the inner-right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile on the distal edges tapering into sharply pointed tips; the left lobe displays a more continuous linear sweep toward the notch than the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity white clusters concentrated on the distal tips of both lobes, particularly the far right tip, consistent with focal colonization or scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigmentation, most prominent on the mid-to-lower section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and irregular tissue loss on the terminal edge of the right lobe; pervasive linear rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a unique, deep secondary notch or irregular jagged segment on the trailing edge of the right lobe proximal to the median notch.
